text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm accompanying Symboli Rudolf to the Fleetfoot Festival, a celebration for Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I gave the course a test run. The positioning of the targets and the condition of the equipment all seems to be in order. The archery planning committee has done an excellent job.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Student A
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you very much, President! We're so lucky to have you performing the inspection personally!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Student B
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, President. Could we trouble you for some guidance for this year's archers?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It would be my pleasure. To call it noblesse oblige may be a bit much, but it is undeniably my duty to bestow my knowledge upon them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Symboli Rudolf spends the day making sure the Fleetfoot Festival goes smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your words at the closing ceremony were wonderful, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Air Groove. Now, if you'll excuse me…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Of course. Well, the festivities have come to a close. All that's left now is to enjoy the rest of the day. After all, everybody needs a breather every once in a while, including you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …? And what do we have here?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Lady
text_block_list.text: Thanks for all your hard work, President! We've extended our opening hours for the day!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, we didn't check out the stalls.
Come to think of it, we didn't check out the stalls.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You arranged all this for me? You really shouldn't have…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I would have to be the most heartless of tyrants to disregard such a courteous act. I shall be sure to savor this opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're a great shot, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Aha, thank you. I do have some shooting range experience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes. My grandfather took me on a few trips to America, where I had the opportunity to try my hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Symboli Rudolf has an explanation for her shooting skills, her talents don't end there.

text_block_list.name: Cookie Cutting Stall Owner
text_block_list.text: H-heavens! I've never seen anyone cut a cookie that intricate with such precision! You're unbelievably dexterous!

text_block_list.name: Cotton Candy Stall Owner
text_block_list.text: Cotton candy! Make your own cotton candy for only a hundred yen! Whoa, President, you're really good at this!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, thank you very much. It appears I still have the muscle memory from when I used to enjoy handicraft. I suppose it is like riding a bike.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Hm? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I would hardly say everything…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But, come to think of it, passing on knowledge and experience is a thing of great importance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer. I am generally the one who comes to you seeking advice… but just for tonight, what if I were to impart my wisdom unto you?
choice_data_list: What happened to taking a breather?
What happened to taking a breather?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But it is. My proposition is a breath of fresh air for the both of us. Why don't we take advantage of this opportunity to both experience a fresh perspective?
choice_data_list: Okay, then. How about some shooting tips?
I want to know how to make picturesque cotton candy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh. Shall we head back to the stall, then?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer… Which prize takes your fancy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Urged to choose by Symboli Rudolf, I point at the prize that's caught my eye—the one on the highest shelf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: An excellent choice… Well then, allow me to assess your skills. Now, look down the sight…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text: Ah, not quite! But nice try!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, you still have plenty more shots. Try to visualize the trajectory and adjust your aim after any misses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking Symboli Rudolf's words to heart, I assume a more comfortable position by resting my elbow on the counter. As I'm adjusting my aim…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something lightly brushes my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …My apologies. I was too close.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I hope you will forgive me. I felt that I had to share your point of view in order to offer satisfactory advice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Not bad. Your aim is nearly on target. Try aiming a bit farther to the bottom-right—yes, like that. Go ahead and give it another try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf whispers words of encouragement in my ear, and I adjust the muzzle according to her advice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Trainer! The prize is yours!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your instruction!
It's all thanks to your instruction!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well, that is quite some praise! I've only been your instructor for a single evening, but what a rewarding one it has been.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get the feeling that Symboli Rudolf's expression seems warmer than usual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Picturesque," you say. Heh. Well, if I am to meet your expectations, I will need to muster all of my skill.

text_block_list.name: Cotton Candy Stall Owner
text_block_list.text: Oh, President! Nice to see you again! Would you like another go at the cotton candy machine?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm afraid not, but my trainer would. Right, now hold out the chopstick…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm… You should hold it up a little higher. Gather the sugar by twirling the stick around… Good, now move it toward the bottom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try using the chopstick to fashion the cotton candy into the same shape as Symboli Rudolf's earlier effort, but to no avail.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. Let me give you a demonstration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf places her hands on mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes, this angle should work. Exactly. Now spin it like so.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Next, tilt the chopstick upwards… Very good. That should do nicely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …And voila!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Retracting the chopstick from the cotton candy machine, I can hardly believe that the picture-perfect cotton candy before me is my own doing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Give it another try while the feeling is still fresh. Perhaps you could make one for me this time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I do my very best to make a nice, big ball of cotton candy just for Symboli Rudolf.
